run_metadata.coverage_summary: WebSearch-only discovery run under a persistent hard egress block (all direct HTTPS to tender hosts denied by the session network policy; WebFetch to tender.gov.au, tenders.nsw/vic/wa/act, ausconnect.dfat.gov.au all returned DNS ENOTFOUND again this run). Tier 1 Commonwealth and state portals (AusTender/DFAT, buy.nsw, Tenders ACT, QTenders, Tenders WA) were swept via WebSearch snapshots; Tier 2 (universities, water/electricity networks, regional WA development-commission bulletins) and Tier 3 (SAP Ariba / SAP Business Network Discovery, major-buyer e-sourcing hubs) were sampled. Two recent, currently-open, buyer-corroborated opportunities were captured at headline level: a WA Government EOI for additional capacity at Kwinana Bulk Jetty and the DFAT PNG Health Program ENABLE RFEOI. No buyer detail page, feed/API or tender document could be opened, so every capture is headline-only and unverified on the live portal.
gaps: HARD EGRESS BLOCK (unchanged, re-tested this run): all direct HTTPS to buyer tender hosts is denied by the session network policy. WebFetch to www.tenders.gov.au, www.tenders.nsw.gov.au, www.tenders.vic.gov.au and ausconnect.dfat.gov.au each returned DNS ENOTFOUND this run, so no buyer-originated detail page, RSS/JSON feed, API or tender document could be opened. To restore full discovery these hosts should be allowed in the session network settings: www.tenders.gov.au, buy.nsw.gov.au / info.buy.nsw.gov.au, www.tenders.nsw.gov.au, www.tenders.vic.gov.au / buyingfor.vic.gov.au, qtenders.epw.qld.gov.au / supply.qld.gov.au, www.tenders.wa.gov.au, www.tenders.sa.gov.au, www.tenders.tas.gov.au, tendersonline.nt.gov.au, www.tenders.act.gov.au, www.vendorpanel.com.au, service.ariba.com, gateway.icn.org.au, www.dfat.gov.au / ausconnect.dfat.gov.au, and individual council/university/utility/corporate sites.

Both tenders captured this run are headline-only and UNVERIFIED on the buyer's own opened page. The Kwinana Bulk Jetty EOI is anchored on an official WA Government media statement (wa.gov.au); its tender_id, closing time, submission mechanics, EOI documents and detailed scope were not opened on Tenders WA and are null. The DFAT ENABLE RFEOI scope is from DFAT's own published development page and PNG ENABLE concept note, but its ATM id (DFAT-1113), closing time (10:00am ACT), value (AUD 85M) and industry-briefing date come from the DevelopmentAid aggregator as a corroboration signal, not from an opened AusTender record, and need verification on AusTender.

Tenders ACT: a single WebSearch snapshot surfaced December-closing ACT references this run but with reference formats and descriptions that CONFLICT with the formats seen in prior runs (e.g. an id previously described as a Canberra Health Services RFT appeared this run as a City & Environment road-construction RFT). Because the ACT snapshots cannot be internally reconciled or opened on the live portal, no ACT item was captured as a tender this run. SL20260630 (Suburban Land Agency, close date reported as 1 Dec vs 3 Dec across snapshots) remains unresolved and is noted for live verification.

Tier 3 corporate (SAP Ariba Discovery / SAP Business Network Discovery, BHP GCMS, Rio Tinto / Fortescue / Woodside Ariba, Coles/Woolworths, bank/telco/energy e-sourcing hubs, EstimateOne subcontractor packages) remained registration-gated or invitation-only; no authenticated supplier session is available, so no corporate opportunity could be read. SAP Business Network Discovery returned no publicly-visible open Australian RFx via WebSearch this run. Corporate portals are recorded in discovered_sources only; no corporate tender was fabricated. Invitation-only / shortlisted RFx (e.g. the TfNSW Mandalong Road Upgrade D&C, now at shortlisted-proposal stage) are out of scope and were not captured.

WebSearch index lags the run date (2026-11-23) and is US-indexed. Many surfaced notices had already closed (e.g. AEMO SWIS-wide System Restart EOI closed 9 Nov; various Victorian water and Western Power ICT EOIs) and were correctly excluded. Genuinely fresh (last 24-48h) buyer-originated notices are almost certainly undercounted this run.
recommended_seed_additions: Consolidated Tenders / Procure Connect — the procurement-platform operator that runs the Buying for Victoria, Tenders SA and Tenders ACT portals (and NZ GETS). Worth tracking for portal rebrands/migrations rather than as a buyer in its own right.

Government of WA media-statements channel (wa.gov.au/government/media-statements) — a reliable early-signal source for WA market soundings/EOIs (e.g. the Kwinana Bulk Jetty capacity EOI) that often precede the formal Tenders WA listing.

tenders.source_name: Government of Western Australia — Media Statement / Tenders WA
tenders.title: Expression of Interest — Additional Trade Capacity at Kwinana Bulk Jetty
tenders.buyer: Government of Western Australia (Ports portfolio / Fremantle Ports)
tenders.category: Ports and maritime infrastructure / market sounding
tenders.description: The WA Government has called for expressions of interest from industry to explore additional trade capacity at Kwinana Bulk Jetty, a strategically important piece of State port infrastructure. Announced via a Government of WA media statement on 6 November 2026 (Ports Minister Stephen Dawson), the EOI seeks market interest from proponents in using or expanding capacity at the jetty.
tenders.deliverables_summary: Proponents are invited to register interest in developing or utilising additional trade/throughput capacity at Kwinana Bulk Jetty. The Government's stated outcome is to test market appetite and options for expanding the jetty's trade capacity. Full scope, respondent obligations and any works/services split were not published in the media statement and sit in the EOI documents on Tenders WA, which could not be opened this run.
tenders.eligibility: Open market sounding — industry participants with an interest in additional trade capacity at Kwinana Bulk Jetty.
tenders.submission_method: Via Tenders WA (EOI record); registration details in the EOI documents (not opened this run)
tenders.delivery_location: Kwinana Bulk Jetty, Kwinana / Cockburn Sound, Western Australia
tenders.reasoning: Discovered via WebSearch surfacing the official Government of WA media statement (wa.gov.au, dated 6 Nov 2026); corroborated by Westport WA and The DCN maritime coverage. Buyer-originated (WA Government); the formal EOI is expected on Tenders WA. Distinct from the separate Westport/Fremantle Ports 'Kwinana Bulk Terminal Redevelopment — Marine Infrastructure' Design & Construct EOI (July 2026).
tenders.notes: Headline-only. Egress block prevented opening the Tenders WA EOI record and documents, so tender_id, closing time, submission mechanics and detailed scope are null/unverified. Closing date (23 Dec 2026) and publish date (6 Nov 2026) are from the WA Government media statement. Must be confirmed on the live Tenders WA portal.

tenders.jurisdiction: Australia — Commonwealth (program delivered in Papua New Guinea)
tenders.title: Managing Contractor — PNG Health Program ENABLE (Enhanced National Advice, Bilateral partnership, and Learning and Evidence)
tenders.buyer: Department of Foreign Affairs and Trade (DFAT)
tenders.category: Health systems strengthening / development program management (managing contractor)
tenders.procurement_type: RFEOI (Request for Expressions of Interest — stage 1 of a two-stage process)
tenders.description: DFAT is seeking a managing contractor to implement the PNG Health Program ENABLE, which supports delivery of the PNG–Australia Health Partnership Strategy 2024–2034 by strengthening selected national health systems and functions. This Request for Expressions of Interest is the first stage of a two-stage procurement, intended to establish a shortlist of capable organisations.
tenders.deliverables_summary: A managing contractor to implement the ENABLE health investment in Papua New Guinea from 2027 — providing enhanced national (health) advice, supporting the Australia–PNG bilateral partnership, and running a learning-and-evidence function to strengthen selected PNG national health systems and functions. This RFEOI stage asks respondents to demonstrate capability to shortlist for the subsequent RFT stage.
key_deliverables: Managing-contractor services to implement the PNG Health Program ENABLE from 2027
Enhanced national health advice to support PNG health systems
Support to the Australia–PNG bilateral health partnership
Learning and evidence function (monitoring, learning, evidence generation)
tenders.scope_of_work: Per DFAT's published development page and the PNG ENABLE concept note: deliver a managing-contractor model to support implementation of the PNG–Australia Health Partnership Strategy 2024–2034, strengthening selected national systems and functions. Full scope sits in the RFEOI documents on AusTender, which could not be opened this run.
tenders.eligibility: Open RFEOI to establish a shortlist of capable organisations (stage 1 of a two-stage process).
tenders.contract_term: Initial 5-year term from 2027, with possible extension up to 2037
tenders.briefing: DFAT states it will hold an industry briefing during the RFEOI period (date not published in the sources read this run).
tenders.delivery_location: Papua New Guinea (managed by DFAT, Commonwealth of Australia)
tenders.detail_source: DFAT development business-notification page (dfat.gov.au) and the published PNG ENABLE concept note (scope/term); ATM id, closing date/time and value corroborated via the DevelopmentAid aggregator — not opened on AusTender directly.
tenders.reasoning: Discovered via WebSearch; DFAT's own published development page corroborated the RFEOI nature, two-stage process, scope and 2027 start / up-to-2037 term. The ATM id (DFAT-1113), closing date (1 Dec 2026, 10:00am ACT), publish date (5 Nov 2026) and indicative value (AUD 85M) were corroborated via the DevelopmentAid aggregator used only as a discovery/corroboration signal; the buyer-originated source recorded is DFAT/AusTender.
tenders.notes: Headline-only. Egress block prevented opening the AusTender ATM record and RFEOI documents, so closing time, exact value, industry-briefing date and evaluation criteria are from an aggregator or the concept note and need verification on AusTender. value (AUD 85M) is an aggregator figure, not confirmed on the DFAT/AusTender notice.
